cohort: 347 pregnant women (159 post-term, 188 term) aged 18-35 years
finding: Post-term pregnancy was associated with a higher proportion of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes and complications compared to term pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in the post-term pregnancy group (42.8%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was significantly lower in the post-term group (0.6%).
